objective: Keep an ACTIVE sprint's pipeline fed without manufacturing work. (1) cash_modes gains pipeline_target INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 5 through a new migration pair (confirm free numbers on both chains), set at activation and changeable by the existing ADMIN lifecycle route. (2) A pure replenishmentDecision(snapshot) in server/services/cash/replenish.ts counts live workable pipeline from the derived tiers (CANDIDATE and above, not retired per cash-autonomy-2 if merged, not EXECUTING/DELIVERING/COLLECTED/ARCHIVED) and returns how many discovery rounds to open this tick: 0 when at or above target; otherwise min(target - live, 3). runDiscovery passes that as openDiscovery's limit instead of the constant 1. nextRoundFor's barren rule and one-live-round-per-bucket are unchanged and still bind, and ROUND_COOL_OFF_MS may be halved only for buckets whose last round found something. (3) When below target and every bucket is barren or cooling, the Cash view and cash-report say so in words ('no bucket has a good opening to ask about right now; next eligible at <time>') rather than opening anything. (4) One narrow read: rounds by project (indexed) and the opportunities already loaded by operate; no new per-tick full scan. (5) tests/cashReplenishment.test.ts: below target opens more than one round in a tick, at target opens none, barren buckets are never re-asked to hit the number, the honest sentence appears when nothing is eligible.
expectedOutcome: A sprint does not drain to zero after failures, and never invents work to hit a number.
nonGoals: A second opportunity pipeline, queue, scheduler or polling loop beside the durable Russell tick and operate()
Changing the evidence gate, verification, audit roles or approval envelopes
A full-table read on every tick; every new read is narrow, indexed and bounded

acceptanceConditions.statement: tests/cashReplenishment.test.ts passes on SQLite and Postgres

rollbackRequirement: Revert the commits; any migration only adds columns with defaults or a nullable column.
